title: Transfer challenge can lock fewer than the stated 3 opponent guesses
steps: Start a season Transfer Challenge and run the 15-minute window to expiry, or have both managers request an early end.
At private guess entry, enter only 1 valid opponent guess and leave guesses 2 and 3 empty.
Press LOCK MY GUESSES and accept the partial-lock confirmation.
Repeat with the other manager, then enter signings and finish the challenge.
expected: The game should require 3 opponent guesses from each manager before guesses can be locked, matching the on-screen rule '3 OPPONENT GUESSES'.
actual: The UI explicitly offers to lock a partial set, and both protocol/provider validators accept any guess array with length 0 through 3, so the challenge can complete with fewer than 3 guesses.
root_cause: Guess validation enforces only a maximum of 3, while production UI code treats partial guess entry as a valid lockable state.

fix.change: If the rule is exactly 3 guesses, require guess arrays to contain exactly 3 valid slots and do not allow partial-lock confirmation for guesses. Keep partial signing entry allowed because signings are explicitly 'MAX 3'. If fewer guesses are intentionally allowed, change the displayed rule to 'UP TO 3 OPPONENT GUESSES' instead.

assumptions: The displayed rule '3 OPPONENT GUESSES' means each manager must make exactly three guesses, not merely up to three.
